facts.fact: The e-Government Agency (eGA) issued the e-Government Interoperability Framework (e-GIF), document eGA/EXT/GIF/001 version 1.0, approved by its CEO in February 2016, setting common standards and technical guidelines for Public Institutions to exchange data.

systems.owner: e-Government Agency (eGA), President's Office Public Service Management

note: The captured text gives no decree or enforcing body (implementation and enforcement section not in the capture) and no count of bodies exchanging data, so no fact on use.
